We do not have an official recommendation as we do not perform the gluing process in the factory. However, I believe this product is suitable for the task as it can bond glass and plastic, and is resistant to temperature, water, and vibration.
Please refer to the glue's instruction manual for specific guidance.
Loctite Extreme Glue Gel (loctiteproducts.com)
